name: Antler US
identity_check: Antler US: the United States arm of Antler (antler.co), with its own location page (antler.co/location/us, headed 'Antler in the US'), offices in NYC, SF and Austin, and its own team led by Bob Rosin (Managing Partner, US). Team bios on that page say 'Antler US'. Only US funds, people, terms and deals are recorded; the global parent is the separate record 'antler' and the India arm is 'antler-india'. Not Antler Elevate (Antler's later-stage fund) and not unrelated 'Antler' companies.
